headline: Pakistan have named a 14-member squad led by Babar Azam for the two-match World Test Championship series against Sri Lanka, with maiden call-ups for Sameer Minhas, Mohammad Taha and Mohammad Suleman, while former captain Shan Masood has been dropped.

card.desc: Babar Azam leads 14-man squad; three uncapped, Shan Masood dropped.

caption:
Pakistan have named a 14-member squad led by Babar Azam for the two-Test World Test Championship series against Sri Lanka, with maiden call-ups for Sameer Minhas, Mohammad Taha and Mohammad Suleman, Geo News reports. Former captain Shan Masood has been dropped, and the Tests will be played in Rawalpindi from 9 November and Lahore from 17 November, Dawn adds.
